Here’s a Facebook post draft you can use (or tweak) to share your business and podcast with friends and family:  

---

✨ Hey friends & fam ✨  

You all know I usually keep business and personal life pretty separate… but today I’d love your support with something that means a lot to me.  

Over the past year, I’ve been building **my business and podcast, The Aesthetic & Wellness Edge**, where I get to sit down with leaders in aesthetics, health, and wellness to share real stories, strategies, and inspiration for growth. 🎙️💡  

This project has been a huge passion of mine, and one of the best ways you can help me grow it is simple:  
👉 Subscribe to the channel  
👉 Share it with someone you know who’d enjoy it  
👉 Engage with a post or two so it reaches more people  

Your support not only helps me, but it also opens doors for new conversations, collaborations, and opportunities within my circle. Networking through friends and family means the world. 💛  

Here’s the link: [insert your podcast/YouTube link]  

Thank you for cheering me on — I couldn’t do this without my people. 🙏  

---
